page_title: TOR 3-0 ATA | Torino v Atalanta 04/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' 3 - 0 Goal! Nikola Vlasic plays it to Duvan Zapata (Torino), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Juan Musso. 3:0.
90+2' Here is a change. Raoul Bellanova is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Koffi Djidji (Torino).
90+1' Substitution. Aleksey Miranchuk will be replaced by Michel Adopo (Atalanta).

90+1' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
89' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) passes the ball onto Duvan Zapata, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
88' Ivan Ilic (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Juan Musso comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanabria will be replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Samuele Ricci (Torino) coming on for Karol Linetty.
83' The ball is cleared after Antonio Sanabria (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
81' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

81' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Atalanta earn a corner.

77' Ivan Ilic (Torino) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the middle of the goal, but Juan Musso makes a nice save.
75' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
75' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Torino.
75' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) plays a one-two with Antonio Sanabria, but the move breaks down.

73' What a poor attempt! Ivan Ilic (Torino) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

72' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
71' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
69' Karol Linetty (Torino) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Juan Musso comes off the line to clear the ball away.
68' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes a short corner kick.
67' Emil Holm (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
66' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
63' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
60' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
59' Emil Holm (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
58' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
56' 2 - 0 Goal! Antonio Sanabria (Torino) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Juan Musso.
56' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
56' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

55' Play continues despite the shouts by some Torino players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Marco Piccinini interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

54' Wasted effort! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
54' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
53' Ivan Ilic (Torino) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
53' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Torino have a corner.
51' The ball is cleared after Raoul Bellanova (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) plays a terrific long ball forward to Duvan Zapata, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) is replaced by Emil Holm.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) comes off for Luis Muriel.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Marco Piccinini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+1' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a low pass into the box, towards Antonio Sanabria. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Duvan Zapata (Torino) tries to find Nikola Vlasic, but he puts too much power on the pass.
41' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
40' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Piccinini interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Atalanta get a free kick.
38' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

36' Adrien Tameze (Torino) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
35' Corner kick. Karol Linetty (Torino) is ready to send the ball into the box.
33' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
32' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle after Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Atalanta.

30' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
29' Neat link-up play between Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) and Duvan Zapata, but Juan Musso reads the game well and the move breaks down.
27' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
27' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
26' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle and signals a foul after Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) brought his opponent down.
25' Ederson (Atalanta) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and makes a decent save.
22' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Nikola Vlasic laid the ball off to Duvan Zapata (Torino), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
20' Duvan Zapata (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Berat Djimsiti is substituted due to injury. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
18' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Juan Musso was alert and made a comfortable save.
18' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) produces a cunning chipped pass for Duvan Zapata, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to find Ademola Lookman, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
16' Ederson (Atalanta) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ademola Lookman, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
15' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
14' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
14' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

13' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
11' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
9' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
6' A pass from Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is intercepted by Juan Musso and the move breaks down.
5' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Karol Linetty (Torino) for his blatant foul.
5' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Duvan Zapata (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
1' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) picks out Duvan Zapata with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
1' The first half has just begun.
Torino will kick-off.
Marco Piccinini was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
